seriesTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power

episodes.title: A Shadow of the Past
episodes.summary: Galadriel is disturbed by signs of an ancient evil's return. Arondir makes an unsettling discovery. Elrond is presented with an intriguing new venture. Nori breaks the Harfoot community's most deeply-held rule.

episodes.title: Adrift
episodes.summary: Galadriel finds a new ally. Elrond faces a cold reception from an old friend. Nori endeavors to help a Stranger. Arondir searches for answers while Bronwyn warns her people of a threat.

episodes.title: Adar
episodes.summary: Arondir finds himself a captive. Galadriel and Halbrand explore a legendary kingdom. Elendil is given a new assignment. Nori faces the consequences.

episodes.title: The Great Wave
episodes.summary: Queen Regent Míriel's faith is tested; Isildur finds himself at a crossroads; Elrond uncovers a secret; Arondir is given an ultimatum; Theo disobeys Bronwyn.

episodes.title: Partings
episodes.summary: Nori questions her instincts. Elrond struggles to stay true to his oath. Halbrand weighs his destiny. The Southlanders brace for attack.

episodes.title: Udûn
episodes.summary: Adar and his army march on Ostirith.

episodes.title: The Eye
episodes.summary: Survivors of a cataclysm try to find safety. The Harfoots confront evil. Durin is torn between friendship and duty. Adar considers a new name.

episodes.title: Elven Kings Under the Sky
episodes.summary: Sauron bargains with Adar. The Stranger and Nori venture into new lands. The Three Elven Rings face judgment.

episodes.title: Where the Stars are Strange
episodes.summary: Darkness falls over Khazad-dûm. Sauron and Galadriel each seek new allies. The Stranger and Harfoots encounter a growing threat.

episodes.title: The Eagle and the Sceptre
episodes.summary: Isildur and an old friend reunite. Arondir grapples with change. Míriel faces rising opposition. Annatar counsels Celebrimbor.

episodes.title: Eldest
episodes.summary: The Stranger finds what he's been searching for. Arondir and Isildur search for Theo. Galadriel and Elrond walk into a trap.

episodes.title: Halls of Stone
episodes.summary: When Durin grows suspicious of the Dwarven Rings, Celebrimbor must reassess his priorities. Amidst Númenor's shifting currents, Elendil searches for hope.

episodes.title: Where Is He?
episodes.summary: Galadriel considers a proposition. Elendil faces judgment. The Stranger finds himself at a crossroads. Sauron's plans bear fruit.

episodes.title: Shadow and Flame
episodes.summary: Season Finale. The free peoples of Middle-earth struggle against the forces of darkness.
